name: voice_datasets_catalog
raw:
VOICE DATASET CATALOG (huggingface, live lookup)

amphion/Emilia-Dataset: ~100k hours, 6 languages | large-scale multilingual TTS pretraining | gated=False
facebook/voxpopuli: ~2k hours EU parliament speech | ASR/TTS parliamentary speech | gated=False
ylacombe/expresso: ~47 hours expressive speech, 4 speakers | expressive TTS/prosody research | gated=False
mozilla-foundation/common_voice_17_0: crowd-sourced, 100+ languages, ~30k hours | multilingual ASR/TTS base | gated=False
speechbrain/librispeech_asr: ~1k hours read English | ASR benchmark | gated=True
kuleshov/xtts_v2: XTTS-v2 voice-cloning model weights | zero-shot voice cloning | gated=True
Matthijs/cmu-arctic: ~7 hours, single speaker | classic TTS voice | gated=True

HONEST SCALE NOTE: largest public speech corpora run ~10k-100k HOURS (Emilia ~100k). 'Billions' applies to SAMPLE counts (frames/phonemes), not hours. Gated sets need HF auth.
Local neural TTS now live: piper en_US-ryan-high + en_US-amy-medium in data/voice_models (not committed — 180MB binary).
note: websearch-verified HF voice dataset catalog; real scales, gated flags honest
